verdict.rationale: Factory documents multiple concurrency mechanisms for an engineering lead: multi-agent Missions launched via `/missions` or `droid exec --mission`, a Sessions API to programmatically create/drive many Droid sessions, `droid exec` as a headless one-shot mode for CI/CD and batch processing, and a Software Factory dashboard to monitor active missions, worker progress, and per-developer/team usage across projects and machines. This directly maps to running many agent tasks in parallel to scale delivery throughput.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual large-scale concurrent execution (numbers, limits, or real-world scaling reports) beyond first-party docs.
